verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs describe DLSS 4/Multi Frame Generation, path tracing, and Reflex as performance features that would enable high-refresh 4K play, and a TechPowerUp review confirms the card exists and runs cool/quiet, but no cited evidence gives actual independent 4K/high-refresh FPS benchmark numbers corroborating the vendor's performance claims. Missing for 10: independent game benchmark FPS/refresh-rate data at 4K, third-party comparison against vendor performance charts.
